title: Does serum-iron–cell-size coupling add RDW information beyond routine measures? An exploratory recruitment-wave transport test
abstract: A serum-iron–MCV product did not establish improved contemporaneous RDW prediction beyond nonlinear routine measures in exploratory NHANES2009–2010 to2015–2016 transfer (5,184 source; 4,673 target adults): weighted MSE difference 0.000451 percentage-points², jointPSU-bootstrap95% interval [-0.002245, 0.013012].
